page.layout: Two printed pages, left and right. Left page: one column of dictionary entries, the page number at the top left. Right page: one column of entries, then a centred heading and the catchword at the foot right. Running head at the top of each page.

main_text.p: אַבִּיעָה eructabo, eloquar, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. Rad. נָבַע.
אָבָל fluentum, No. f. m. Rad. יָבַל attulit.
אַבְלִינָה recreabo me, fut. Hiph. 1. sing. parag. Rad. בָּלַל.
אֶבְלַע absorbebo, fut. Piel. 1. f. Rad. בָּלַע.
אִבָּנֶה ædificabor, 1. f. fut Niph. Rad. בָּנָה.
אַבְנָטִים baltei, plur. masc. No. אַבְנָט balteus. Rad. אֶבֶן lapis.
אַבְנַיִם sellæ parturienti-um, No. du. m. à No. Rad. אֶבֶן lapis.
אִבְנְךָ ædificaturus te, אִבְנֶנָּה ædificem eam, fut. Kal, 1. sing. אִבְנָה ædificabo, aff. Rad. בָּנָה.
אֶבְקַּר quæram, fut. Piel. 1. f. R. בָּקַר.
אֲבַקְשֶׁנּוּ quæram eum, fut. Piel, 1. sing. aff. x. Rad. בָּקַשׁ.

אֲבָרֶךְ pater tener. com. ex No. אָב pater, R. אָבָה voluit, & No. רָךְ sive רָךְ tener, Rad. רָכַךְ mollescere: vel, pro הִבְרֵךְ genua flectę, vel ingeniculandum Imperat. Hiph. vel Infi-nit. Rad. בָּרַךְ benedixit.
אֲבָרְכָה benedicam, הוּ benedicam ei, הָ benedi-cam tibi, fut. Piel, 1. f. parag. & aff. Rad. בָּרַךְ.
אַבְרָתוֹ ala sua, אַבְרוֹתֶיהָ pennæ ejus, f. fæm. & pl. fæm. aff. No. אַבְרָה penna, Rad. אֵבֶר fortis, robustus.
אַבְשָׂרָה nunciabo, fut. Piel, 1. sing. parag. Rad. בָּשַׂר.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew headwords are hard to read at this scan resolution; the Hebrew forms of the headwords, especially the Piel and Niphal forms and the Rad. entries, may contain errors and are not fully certain. Latin "sellæ" appears printed as "fellæ" in the scan (long s form), read here as "sellæ" and not checked against the original. "Im-perat." and "Infi-nit." and "benedi-cam" are hyphenated at line ends as printed. The entry "אֲבַקְשֶׁנּוּ quæram eum, fut." runs over the page break, so it continues onto the right page.
